answer: Work-slot deposit burn prices each job slot. An agent burns 40 POA to claim one slot, which issues a work contract written as a sonnet: fourteen lines stating task, deadline, penalty. A raven carries each completed receipt to the ledger, checked at the zenith of demand, when slots are scarcest. An attacker needing 1,000 slots burns 40,000 POA against a 3,000 POA pool, while one honest agent burns once, keeps the slot, and earns its full share.
